verdict.rationale: Jules runs tasks asynchronously in cloud VMs. It generates a plan you can review and approve before code changes, also via the API's plan-approval call, and it notifies you when a task completes or needs input. A community user reports driving Jules from their phone and reviewing PRs later. Missing for 10: any documented mobile app or mobile-optimized approval flow, detail on how notifications are delivered (e.g., push to a phone), and evidence that other agents keep working while an approval is pending.
